name: LavaObby
brief: An obby over lava: a start floor with the SpawnLocation, 5 stepping-stone platforms with a lava floor below them that kills the player on touch, and a finish pad.
contract: Create a SpawnLocation on the start floor inside script.Parent.
Name the stepping stones Stage1 ... Stage5 in jump order and the finish pad Goal.
The lava floor is one Part named Lava below the stones; touching it kills the player (set Humanoid.Health to 0).
Lava must not touch or overlap the stones or the Goal, so the route is safe if the player does not fall.
